class.name: RailVehicleHeating
class.brief_description: Represents and configures the vehicle's train heating (Clima) power source.
class.description: [RailVehicleHeating] wraps the FIZ [code]Clima:[/code] section, which selects and configures the power source used to heat the train (an onboard generator, an accumulator, a power cable from another vehicle, and so on).

method.name: get_allowed
method.description: The heating switch's own state ([code]HeatingAllow[/code]) - what [code]trainheating_sw:[/code] flips ([code]Train.cpp:6674[/code]).

method.name: heating
method.description: The train heating switched on or off ([code]HeatingSwitch()[/code]; [code]OnCommand_heatingenable/disable[/code], [code]Train.cpp:5256-5296[/code]).

members.member: [code]Clima:HMaxVoltage[/code] Maximum voltage of the electric heating circuit, in volts.
[code]Clima:Heating[/code] Power source for the train heating circuit.
